commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+4' The free kick from Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) failed to provide any scoring opportunity, as one of the defenders did a good job and knocked it out.
90+3' Girona seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
90+1' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
88' Girona have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
87' Daley Blind (Girona) hammers the ball from far out, but his shot is blocked by an opposition player. Now Girona have a corner.
86' Girona failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

86' Abel Ruiz (Girona) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball. The ball goes out of play. Girona are awarded a corner kick.
84' Mallorca take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
84' Substitution. Antonio Sanchez makes his way off the pitch and Siebe Van Der Heyden (Mallorca) comes on as his replacement.
83' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to substitute Cyle Larin and he is replaced by Abdon Prats (Mallorca).
81' Referee Francisco Maeso has finally had enough of Jagoba Arrasate and brandishes a yellow card at him!
78' Having seen unsporting behavior, Francisco Maeso shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Abdon Prats (Mallorca) is the recipient.
77' Yaser Asprilla (Girona) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
77' Jose Copete (Mallorca) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle. Girona will take a free kick near the side line.
75' Cristhian Stuani (Girona) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Dominik Greif, who smothers the ball.
73' The referee signals a substitution. Robert Navarro (Mallorca) is brought on as a substitute for Manu Morlanes.
73' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to make a change. Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) replaces Sergi Darder.
73' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Portu (Girona) is coming onto the pitch as Oriol Romeu cannot continue after picking up an injury.
72' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
70' What a big chance! Abel Ruiz (Girona) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball just over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mallorca.
66' Francisco Maeso shows a yellow card to Martin Valjent (Mallorca), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
65' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Dominik Greif intercepts the ball.
63' Michel has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ivan Martin (Girona) replacing Donny van de Beek.
63' Substitution. Abel Ruiz (Girona) has come on for Arnaut Danjuma.
63' The resulting corner from Arnaut Danjuma (Girona) is cleared.
62' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Arnaut Danjuma (Girona). The ball goes out for a corner. Girona can continue in their attacking effort.
62' Girona are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
60' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
57' Here is a change. Juanpe is going off and Michel gives the last tactical orders to Gabriel Misehouy (Girona).
57' Here comes a substitution. Bryan Gil is given a rest as he is replaced by Cristhian Stuani (Girona).
57' Oriol Romeu (Girona) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
56' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
54' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Arnaut Danjuma (Girona), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
51' 2 - 1 GOAL! Keeper Paulo Gazzaniga totally miss kicks his clearance straight to Cyle Larin (Mallorca), who rifles the ball back into the net from close range. It’s now 2:1.

51' Arnaut Danjuma (Girona) takes a sweet touch after collecting a precise cross. He produces a nice effort that whistles just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.
49' Mallorca showcase their great team work by exchanging one-two passes, but one wayward pass sees them lose possession.
47' David Lopez (Girona) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Francisco Maeso had an easy-decision to make.
47' Bryan Gil (Girona) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
46' The Girona players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+5' Francisco Maeso blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.

45+4' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Girona are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
45+3' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Mallorca comes to nothing.

45+2' Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat. The ball is out of play. Mallorca win a corner kick.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
42' Jose Copete (Mallorca) kept talking out of turn to the referee until Francisco Maeso lost patience and pulled out a yellow card.
42' Omar Mascarell (Mallorca) is shown the yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. It could have been worse!
41' Jose Copete (Mallorca) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
40' Arnaut Danjuma (Girona) meets a cross inside the box, but Dominik Greif wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.

37' What a chance that is! Cyle Larin (Mallorca) displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross, but he sends his header just over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Girona.
35' Girona are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
32' Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Francisco Maeso didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
32' Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
32' There's no point in Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) arguing about the referee's decision as it's an obvious red card for a dangerous tackle.

31' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca), but referee Francisco Maeso must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
29' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.

28' Mallorca slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
26' Yaser Asprilla (Girona) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
24' Wonderful movement by Girona. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
20' 1 - 1 Goal! Vedat Muriqi plays a simple square pass into the feet of Cyle Larin (Mallorca) in the box, who composes himself and lashes the ball into the bottom left corner. 1:1.
19' The resulting corner from Arnaut Danjuma (Girona) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
19' Arnaut Danjuma (Girona) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. The linesman makes the right call and Girona will have a corner.
17' Francisco Maeso blows for a foul after Johan Mojica (Mallorca) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
16' Yaser Asprilla (Girona) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
13' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) takes a neat pass, dummies a defender and slams the ball well wide of the left post from the edge of the box.
13' Dominik Greif displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Bryan Gil (Girona) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
10' Mallorca keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
7' 0 - 1 Goal! Donny van de Beek (Girona) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the right side of the goal. It's 0:1.
6' Bryan Gil (Girona) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
4' Mallorca are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears. The linesman signals a throw-in for Mallorca.
2' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Mallorca will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Francisco Maeso.
